questions.enonce_markdown: Make a large labelled diagram of the male reproductive system of a mammal. *(8 marks)*

What is meant by:

(i) Ovulation,

(ii) Fertilization,

(iii) Pollination? *(2,3,3 marks)*
questions.corrige_markdown:
(i) **Ovulation:** the release of a mature **egg cell (ovum)** from a **Graafian follicle** of the **ovary** into the **oviduct (Fallopian tube)**.

(ii) **Fertilization:** the **fusion of the nucleus of a male gamete (sperm / pollen tube nucleus) with the nucleus of a female gamete (ovum)** to form a **zygote** (a diploid cell).

(iii) **Pollination:** the **transfer of pollen grains from the anther** (male part) **to the stigma** (female part) of a flower of the **same species**, by insects, wind, water or other agents.

questions.enonce_markdown: Bring out four (4) differences between an insect pollinated flower and a wind pollinated flower. *(4 marks)*
questions.corrige_markdown:
| Insect pollinated flower | Wind pollinated flower |
|---|---|
| **Large, brightly coloured** petals | Petals **small, dull or absent** |
| Has **scent and nectar** | **No scent or nectar** |
| **Small, sticky or rough stigma**, inside the flower | **Large, feathery** stigma hanging outside the flower to catch pollen |
| Anthers are **inside** the flower and firmly attached | Anthers **hang outside** on long filaments and swing freely in the wind |
| Pollen grains are **larger, sticky or spiny**, produced in **small numbers** | Pollen grains are **small, smooth and light**, produced in **very large numbers** |

(Any four differences.)
